strategies.title: Minimal API migration
strategies.rationale: Only modify src files to adopt Pydantic V2 APIs while keeping test expectations valid without changes.
ordered_steps: Replace User.parse_obj with User.model_validate in src/sample_app/api.py
Replace user.dict(by_alias=True, exclude_none=True) with user.model_dump(by_alias=True, exclude_none=True) in src/sample_app/api.py
Replace Project.parse_raw with Project.model_validate_json in src/sample_app/api.py

strategies.title: Compatibility layer migration
strategies.rationale: Introduce pydantic.v1 import aliases to keep V1-style calls functional under V2 while migrating src files incrementally.
ordered_steps: Add import `from pydantic.v1 import BaseModel, validator, root_validator` at top of src/sample_app/models.py
Replace direct pydantic imports with pydantic.v1 equivalents in src/sample_app/models.py
Update src/sample_app/api.py to use new model_validate/model_dump calls while preserving alias behavior
Pin pyproject.toml to "pydantic>=2,<3" and add pydantic-compat extra if needed

strategies.title: Full refactor to Pydantic V2 idioms
strategies.rationale: Leverage V2 improvements: replace validators with field constraints, remove root_validator, use model_config, and adopt model_dump by default.
ordered_steps: Rewrite src/sample_app/models.py using Pydantic V2 syntax: replace validators with Field constraints, replace root_validator with model_validator, update Config to model_config
Update src/sample_app/api.py to use model_validate and model_dump without by_alias where alias= Field(alias=...) handles it

Migrate test expectations in tests/test_api.py and tests/test_models.py to use model_dump instead of dict(by_alias=True) — note: test files are read-only; this strategy assumes tests already align with V2 or will be updated separately per migration plan
